corrections.caveats: Enricher: fill_rand_i32_len and fill_rand_i64_len put the negative half one digit past the maximum, and at 10-digit i32 and 19-digit i64 an out-of-range double-to-int cast (undefined behaviour) collapses about half the samples to INT32_MIN or INT64_MIN, so the fixed-length signed charts are unreliable; the verify step covers only boundary values and powers.
